title: GTA 6 may have sold 53 million copies already 📈
subject: gta6
description:
Is 53 million believable after one week? 👇

Analytics firm Alinea Analytics estimates GTA 6 sold about 53 million copies and $4.7 billion in its first week, with 75.7% of copies on PS5. Rockstar has not confirmed the figure; its last official number was 32.5 million copies sold before launch.

Sources: Forbes (Nov 27, 2026), GamesRadar+ (Nov 27, 2026), Game*Spark (Nov 28, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 may have sold 53 million in a week.
That's the estimate Alinea Analytics posted on November 27, worth about $4.7 billion.
Rockstar itself has only confirmed 32.5 million copies sold before launch.
Alinea puts 75.7% of copies on PS5. That's roughly 40 million there and 13 million on Xbox.
It also counts 7 million players with more than 50 hours already.
If the estimate holds, GTA 6 has already outsold Cyberpunk 2077 and The Sims. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.
